item.title: Northrop B-2 Spirit
item.description: Outside my phase of loving standing by airport windows watching Boeing planes take off as a child, and my current relative hate of aviation noise above my apartment on a nightly basis, I've had no particular interest in aviation. I have however always to some extent admired the aesthetic, engineering, and physics of the craft. That is to say that my lack of interest in the craft has been completely reoriented by my interest in one magnificent machine. The Northrop B-2 Spirit, fairly named fo...
